title: Word rush game challenge library
globalJudgingRules: Count each answer once per round. Singulars, plurals, obvious inflections, synonyms, and alternate names for the same answer count once.
Sample answers are illustrative, not an exhaustive whitelist. Accept other answers that satisfy the challenge rule.
Use established English names and conventional English spellings for letter and spelling constraints. Do not add arbitrary adjectives to manufacture qualifying names.
Count named types at familiar levels of specificity: for example, shark and hammerhead shark may each count; two names for the same type do not. Apply any narrower challenge rule first.
Where real places, works, or characters share a name, request enough context to identify the answer when needed. A repeated ambiguous name does not earn another point.
Interpret each answer under the displayed challenge and its judging rule. Do not extract conversational filler, incidental mentions, or explicit negations as proposed answers.

challenges.judgingRule: Accept real animals that naturally live in the ocean for at least part of their lives; exclude freshwater-only animals.
Accept real mammals, including marine mammals; exclude birds, reptiles, and fictional creatures.
Accept living reptile groups or species; exclude amphibians and prehistoric animals.
Accept living bird groups or species, including flightless birds.
Accept insects at any life stage; spiders, worms, and centipedes do not qualify.
Accept animals that naturally have hooves; exclude paws and claws.
Accept animals with a hard external shell or carapace; exclude animals with only an internal skeleton.

challenges.prompt: Name animals that begin with B.
challenges.judgingRule: Use an ordinary English animal name beginning with B; do not add a descriptive adjective just to meet the letter.

challenges.prompt: Name animals that begin with S.
challenges.judgingRule: Use an ordinary English animal name beginning with S; established compound names count.
Accept animals capable of powered flight in a normal adult life stage; gliding alone does not qualify.
Accept real tree types, using common names; fruits alone count only when they also name the tree.

challenges.prompt: Name flowering plants grown in gardens.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept named plants grown for flowers; exclude color words and invented varieties.
Accept plants whose leaves or tender stems are used to flavor food; exclude spice-only seeds and bark.
Accept physical hand tools or powered tools used to cultivate or maintain plants.

challenges.prompt: Name parts of a flowering plant.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept standard plant structures; synonyms for the same structure count once.
Accept cone-bearing tree types; exclude broadleaf trees.

challenges.prompt: Name plants that grow as vines or climbers.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept plants that naturally climb or trail; exclude plants merely tied to a support.
Accept plants with true bulbs; exclude plants that grow only from tubers, corms, or rhizomes.

challenges.prompt: Name gardening supplies that are not tools.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept consumable materials or containers used in growing plants; exclude living plants and tools.

challenges.prompt: Name plants that begin with L.
challenges.judgingRule: Use an established common English plant name beginning with L.
Accept edible fruits conventionally served as fruit; exclude nuts and foods primarily treated as vegetables.
Accept foods conventionally prepared as vegetables, even if botanically fruits.
Accept named citrus fruits and established hybrids; exclude citrus-flavored products.
Accept fruits with a single hard stone around the seed; exclude fruits with only small seeds.
Accept plants whose leaves are eaten as vegetables; culinary herbs alone do not qualify.

challenges.prompt: Name edible roots, tubers, or bulbs.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept foods where the named edible portion is a root, tuber, or bulb; exclude aboveground fruits.

challenges.prompt: Name fruits or vegetables beginning with C.
challenges.judgingRule: Use a conventional English produce name beginning with C; culinary definitions apply.

challenges.prompt: Name fruits or vegetables beginning with P.
challenges.judgingRule: Use a conventional English produce name beginning with P; exclude prepared dishes.

challenges.prompt: Name fruits commonly dried and sold as dried fruit.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept named fruits with an established dried-food form; fresh and dried names for the same fruit count once.
Accept edible beans, peas, lentils, and other legume seeds; exclude cereal grains.
Accept established pasta shape names; sauces and complete dishes do not count.
Accept named cheese types; exclude brands unless the name also identifies a cheese type.
Accept recognized bread types, including flatbreads; exclude sandwiches and cakes.
Accept recognized soup varieties; count alternate names for the same variety once.
Accept recognized sweet dishes, baked goods, or confections served as dessert.
Accept named techniques for preparing food; equipment and ingredients alone do not count.
Accept handheld implements used to prepare, cook, or serve food; exclude powered appliances.
Accept named dried plant parts used mainly for seasoning; mixtures are excluded for this challenge.
Accept established edible sauces, spreads, or seasonings added to food; brands alone do not count.
Use an established food or dish name beginning with S; arbitrary adjectives do not create new answers.
Accept recognized footwear types; brands and colors do not create separate answers.
Accept recognized hat styles or head coverings worn as hats; exclude hairstyles.

challenges.prompt: Name garments worn on the upper body.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept clothing that covers some of the torso; underwear and outerwear may count.

challenges.prompt: Name garments worn on the lower body.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept garments primarily worn below the waist; exclude footwear and accessories.
Accept devices or mechanisms that secure clothing; synonyms count once.
Accept established fabric or textile names; exclude colors, prints, and brand names.
Accept recognized jewelry types; material or color changes do not create new items.
Accept items worn on the body to reduce injury or exposure; exclude handheld equipment.

challenges.prompt: Name clothing or accessories beginning with S.
challenges.judgingRule: Use established English names beginning with S; do not prepend colors or other adjectives.
Accept garment types normally made with sleeves; do not count sleeveless variants.
Accept recognized furniture types; colors, materials, and room prefixes alone do not create new answers.

challenges.prompt: Name household appliances powered by electricity.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept named domestic appliances that use electricity; exclude furniture and passive utensils.
Accept items placed on or over a bed for sleeping; exclude the bed frame and bedroom furniture.

challenges.prompt: Name things used to clean a home.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept tools, equipment, or cleaning substances with a direct household cleaning use.
Accept installed bathroom fittings; exclude loose toiletries and cleaning products.
Accept container types used to hold belongings; exclude rooms and storage furniture.
Accept recognized electric light fixture or lamp types; bulb colors do not create new answers.

challenges.prompt: Name parts or fittings of a house.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept structural parts or installed building fittings; loose furniture and appliances do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name household items made primarily of paper.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept familiar paper-based household products; exclude items whose paper component is only packaging.

challenges.prompt: Name objects with wheels used inside a home.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept familiar household objects that roll on attached wheels or casters; exclude toy vehicles.
Accept tools operated directly by hand without a motor; different sizes do not count separately.
Accept portable workshop or construction tools driven by a motor; exclude kitchen appliances.
Accept tools with a cutting blade or edge; specific tool types count, sizes do not.
Accept devices used to measure a quantity; units of measurement do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name fasteners used to join materials.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept physical hardware or joining materials that secure objects together; actions alone do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name tools used to grip or hold workpieces.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept recognized holding or gripping tools; exclude ordinary furniture.
Accept tools directly used to apply, prepare, or remove paint or wallpaper; paint itself does not count.
Accept tools or materials whose working surface removes material by abrasion.

challenges.prompt: Name workshop or construction safety equipment.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept equipment used to prevent or respond to injuries during building or workshop work; generic hand tools do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name materials sold as building supplies.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept construction materials; specific building components and tools do not count.
Accept handheld implements that make marks; stationery that only holds marks does not count.
Accept physical consumable supplies for writing, organizing, or handling documents; exclude electronic devices.
Accept recognized academic subjects; synonyms for the same subject count once.

challenges.prompt: Name items used to organize paper documents.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept physical organizers or binding supplies; exclude digital software.
Accept recognized reference-book categories; individual titles do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name geometric shapes with straight sides.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept standard two-dimensional polygon names; circles and solids do not count.
Accept standard solid shapes; two-dimensional shapes do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name school or office devices powered by electricity.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept equipment with an established school or office use; exclude household-only appliances.

challenges.prompt: Name parts of a printed book.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept named physical or editorial book components; chapter numbers are not separate answers.
Accept standard written English punctuation marks; letters and numerals do not count.
Accept real vehicle types designed to travel on roads; brands and model names do not count.
Accept vehicles designed to run on rails; specific routes and operators do not count.
Accept types of craft that travel on or through water; brands and named individual vessels do not count.
Accept real aircraft types; brands, models, and spacecraft do not count.
Accept recognizable bicycle components; accessories not attached to the bicycle do not count.
Accept vehicle components; brands and general materials do not count.
Accept vehicles propelled by human effort; exclude electric-only and gravity-only devices.
Accept vehicle types used by police, fire, rescue, or emergency medical services.

challenges.prompt: Name vehicle types beginning with S.
challenges.judgingRule: Use established English vehicle names beginning with S; exclude brands and model names.

challenges.prompt: Name things that provide information on a car dashboard.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept named gauges, indicators, warning lights, or displays; synonyms count once.
Accept portable items designed for camping, sleeping outdoors, or maintaining a campsite.
Accept items with an established hiking or trail-navigation use; exclude ordinary food and drinks.

challenges.prompt: Name types of luggage or travel bags.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept recognized bag or luggage types; colors and brands do not create new answers.
Accept recognized temporary or permanent structures that shelter people outdoors; exclude clothing.
Accept instruments, devices, or documents used to determine position or direction; locations do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name items in a first-aid kit.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept recognizable supplies used for immediate treatment of minor injuries; prescription drug names are excluded.
Accept gear used to catch fish recreationally; fish species and unrelated boating equipment do not count.
Accept items designed for beach recreation or swimming; generic clothing and food do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name types of temporary travel accommodation.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept recognized lodging types booked or used by travelers; individual business names do not count.
Accept equipment designed for sports on snow or ice; generic warm clothing does not count.

challenges.prompt: Name sports played with a ball.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept recognized sports whose standard play uses a ball; video games do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name sports played with a racket or paddle.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept recognized sports in which players strike a ball or shuttle with a racket or paddle.
Accept recognized sports performed on snow or ice; recreational equipment alone does not count.
Accept recognized sports performed in or on water; ordinary transport does not count.
Accept recognized athletics event types; changing race distance creates a distinct standard event, not an arbitrary distance.
Accept named board, card, tile, or dice games; video games do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name card games played with a standard playing-card deck.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept established games playable with a standard suited deck, with jokers if needed; proprietary special decks do not qualify.
Accept gear specifically used to reduce injury during sport; ordinary clothing does not count.

challenges.prompt: Name sports venues or playing areas.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept standard names for sport-specific spaces; individual stadium names do not count.
Use a recognized English sport name beginning with B; individual teams do not count.
Accept recognized instrument types; brands and individual named instruments do not count.
Accept instruments whose sound is produced primarily by vibrating strings.
Accept instruments whose sound is produced by vibrating air; brass and woodwind instruments both count.
Accept instruments played primarily by striking, shaking, or scraping; instrument sizes do not count separately.
Accept physical materials used to make drawings, paintings, prints, or sculptures; finished artworks do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name tools used to make visual art.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept implements directly used to draw, paint, print, or sculpt; consumable media alone do not count.
Accept established art forms or media; individual works and broad evaluative terms do not count.
Accept established named dances or dance styles; invented moves do not count.
Accept established genre names; artists and songs do not count.
Use an established English instrument name beginning with C.
Accept real cities anywhere, using common English names beginning with B; repeated city names count once unless different locations are specified.
Accept real cities using common English names beginning with M.
Accept real cities using common English names beginning with S.
Accept real cities using common English names beginning with C.
Accept cities that serve as a national capital; historical capitals alone do not qualify.
Accept cities geographically in Europe; cities spanning Europe and Asia may count.
Accept cities geographically in Asia; cities spanning Asia and Europe may count.
Accept real cities geographically in Africa.
Accept real cities on the South American continent.

challenges.prompt: Name named monuments or historic built landmarks.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept identifiable real monuments, historic buildings, or built sites; generic structures and natural features do not count.
Accept widely recognized sovereign countries geographically in Africa; dependent territories do not count.
Accept widely recognized sovereign countries on the South American continent; dependent territories do not count.
Accept widely recognized sovereign countries wholly or partly in geographic Europe; dependent territories do not count.
Accept widely recognized sovereign countries wholly or partly in geographic Asia; dependent territories do not count.
Accept widely recognized sovereign countries with no coastline on an ocean or an ocean-connected sea.

challenges.prompt: Name countries located entirely on islands.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept widely recognized sovereign countries whose land territory is entirely on islands; territories with continental mainland land do not qualify.
Use common English short country names beginning with M; dependent territories do not count.
Use common English short country names beginning with S; dependent territories do not count.
Accept established named human languages, including signed and historical languages; programming languages do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name languages commonly written using the Latin alphabet.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept languages with an established standard Latin-script writing system; occasional transliteration alone does not qualify.
Accept named kinds of naturally occurring terrain; individual place names and built structures do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name types of bodies of water.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept standard names for kinds of water bodies; individual geographic names do not count.
Accept named atmospheric weather events or conditions; seasons alone do not count.
Accept established gemstone names, including organic gemstones; colors and jewelry types do not count.
Accept named rock types; loose minerals and commercial countertop colors do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name natural sources of fresh water.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept natural features or stores that contain or supply fresh water; manufactured containers do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name things found in the sky outside Earth's atmosphere.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept kinds of natural astronomical objects; individual planet names also count, but satellites made by humans do not.
Accept naturally occurring events or processes capable of causing damage; human-caused accidents do not count.
Accept named real deserts, including polar deserts; countries alone do not count.
Accept named real mountain ranges; individual mountains alone do not count.
Accept recognizable body structures visible externally; internal organs do not count.
Accept standard bone names or familiar names for bones; left and right versions count once.
Accept recognized organs; organ systems and cells alone do not count.
Accept element names from the periodic table; symbols are aliases of the names, not extra answers.
Accept elements classified as metals; alloys and metalloids do not count.
Accept established length units, including standard metric multiples; arbitrary numerical distances do not count.
Accept established time units; arbitrary quantities such as 'three minutes' do not create new answers.
Accept established mass units, including customary units of mass; force units such as newtons do not count.
Accept recognized instruments or apparatus used in scientific laboratory work; chemicals alone do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name substances that are gases at room temperature.
challenges.judgingRule: Use 20 degrees Celsius and normal atmospheric pressure; accept named pure substances, not mixtures such as air.
Accept hardware used to supply data or commands to a computer; software does not count.
Accept hardware used to present or physically produce computer output; software does not count.
Accept physical components located inside a desktop or laptop computer; software and external peripherals do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name data storage media or devices.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept physical media or devices used to retain digital data; online service names do not count.
Accept established programming languages, past or present; markup languages and frameworks do not count.
Accept established named formats or their conventional extensions; the format name and extension count as one answer.

challenges.prompt: Name computer keyboard keys other than letters and digits.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept named key functions; individual function-key numbers and alternate names do not create extra answers.
Accept physical devices designed to send or receive messages, voice, or video; apps alone do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name devices that record sound, images, or video.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept physical capture or recording devices; storage media alone do not count.
Accept recognizable powered electronic device types used by individuals; brands and model numbers do not count.
Accept recognized healthcare job roles; medical specialties may count as distinct roles, but workplaces do not.
Accept recognized jobs involved in constructing or finishing buildings; tools do not count.
Accept recognized jobs preparing or serving food, or providing accommodation.
Accept recognized occupations producing or performing art, design, writing, or entertainment.
Accept recognized scientific research or fieldwork occupations; pseudoscientific roles do not count.
Accept recognized jobs operating vehicles or directly managing passenger or freight transport.

challenges.prompt: Name occupations that work directly with animals.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept recognized roles whose duties directly involve animal care, handling, training, or study.
Use a conventional English occupation name beginning with P; arbitrary adjectives do not qualify.
Accept named kinds of premises where work is performed; specific company names do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name occupations that make or repair physical objects.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept recognized skilled roles that build, fabricate, craft, or repair tangible things.

challenges.prompt: Name English words beginning with B.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept standard English dictionary words beginning with B; exclude proper names, abbreviations, and letter names.

challenges.prompt: Name English words beginning with S.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept standard English dictionary words beginning with S; exclude proper names, abbreviations, and letter names.

challenges.prompt: Name English words beginning with M.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept standard English dictionary words beginning with M; exclude proper names, abbreviations, and letter names.

challenges.prompt: Name English words beginning with C.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept standard English dictionary words beginning with C; exclude proper names, abbreviations, and letter names.

challenges.prompt: Name English words ending in ING.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept standard English words whose final letters are ING; inflections of the same base word count once.

challenges.prompt: Name English words with exactly five letters.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept single English dictionary words with five alphabetic letters; exclude proper names, hyphens, and abbreviations.

challenges.prompt: Name English words with a doubled letter.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept words containing two identical letters next to each other; each word counts once regardless of how many pairs it contains.
Accept words with adjacent letters P and H in that order; pronunciation does not matter.

challenges.prompt: Name English words beginning with BR.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept standard English words whose first two letters are BR; exclude proper names and abbreviations.

challenges.prompt: Name English words ending with K.
challenges.judgingRule: Accept standard English words whose final letter is K; exclude proper names and abbreviations.
Accept identifiable characters from established fairy tales; a generic role must identify its tale if ambiguous.
Accept named fictional characters who investigate mysteries or crimes; real investigators do not count.
Accept named fictional robotic characters; purely biological characters and real robots do not count.
Accept named characters established as superheroes in published fiction; aliases of one character count once.
Accept named locations invented for a published story, film, television series, or game; real locations do not count.
Accept named fictional characters portrayed as animals that speak human language; human characters with animal nicknames do not count.
Accept established creature types from mythology or folklore; individual character names and species invented only for a modern franchise do not count.
Accept established narrative forms; genres and individual titles do not count.
Accept established film genres or subgenres; film titles and subjective quality descriptions do not count.

challenges.prompt: Name fictional characters beginning with S.
challenges.judgingRule: Use an established character name or alias beginning with S; the same character counts once across aliases.
